# TimeCamp

> TimeCamp is an AI-powered time tracking and workforce management platform that automates time logging, productivity monitoring, invoicing, and reporting for distributed teams.

TimeCamp provides comprehensive time tracking solutions with intelligent automation features including AI-driven timesheets, automatic activity monitoring, and integrated billing systems. The platform supports multiple languages and serves businesses of all sizes with tools for employee productivity, project management, and financial reporting.

## Key Topics

- Time Tracking
- AI Time Tracking Agent
- Automated Timesheets
- Employee Monitoring
- Productivity Monitoring
- Activity Monitoring
- Workforce Management
- Project Billing
- Time Intelligence
- Expense Tracking
- Timesheet Approval
- Reporting & Analytics
- Team Collaboration
- Attendance Tracking
- Desktop App
